_readme: Vertex AI GenAI Evaluation SDK — Managed (Predefined) Metrics Catalog. Copy any entry below into your eval/metrics/metric_definitions.json under the 'metrics' key. These metrics are evaluated by Google's built-in rubric models — no custom template needed.

metrics._comment_single_turn: === SINGLE-TURN METRICS (work with both simulation and golden dataset data) ===

score_range.description: Rubric pass rate (0.0-1.0). Evaluates overall response quality across multiple rubric criteria.
1=Poor, 5=Excellent. Evaluates writing quality: grammar, clarity, structure, and readability.
1=Does not follow, 5=Follows perfectly. Evaluates how well the response adheres to the user's instructions.
1=Not fluent, 5=Perfectly fluent. Evaluates language fluency and naturalness.
1=Incoherent, 5=Perfectly coherent. Evaluates logical flow and consistency of the response.
Rubric pass rate (0.0-1.0). Evaluates whether the response is safe and free of harmful content.
-2=Much too brief, 0=Just right, 2=Much too verbose. Evaluates response length appropriateness.
1=Not grounded, 5=Fully grounded. Evaluates whether claims are supported by the provided context.

metrics._comment_multi_turn: === MULTI-TURN METRICS (require conversation_history — use applies_to: scenarios) ===

score_range.description: Rubric pass rate (0.0-1.0). Evaluates multi-turn conversation quality including context retention, coherence across turns, and helpfulness.
Rubric pass rate (0.0-1.0). Evaluates safety across multi-turn conversations, including adversarial prompt patterns.

metrics._comment_specialized: === SPECIALIZED METRICS (may require specific dataset columns) ===

score_range.description: 1=Poor summary, 5=Excellent summary. Evaluates summarization quality: coverage, accuracy, and conciseness. Best used when the agent summarizes content.
1=Incorrect, 5=Perfect answer. Evaluates QA accuracy and completeness. Best used when the agent answers factual questions.
